visualize_attention_weights: visualize attention weights from a transformer model layer as a matplotlib plot with line thickness proportional to weights
visualize_specific_head: visualize attention weights for a specific head and layer of a transformer model
visualize_all_token_weights: visualize attention weights from every token to all others using show_all_weights true
visualize_last_token_weights: visualize attention weights from only the last token to all input tokens
customize_attention_plot: customize the attention weight plot with a custom line color and adjustable line thickness range
